sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: March was a Welsh hero. He was the Welsh corollary to king Mark of the legend of Tristan and Iseult. March was called one of the three seafarers of the island of Britain. He arrived on a boat from the land of the Norsemen. He became the occasional adviser to his cousin king Arthur.

okr.objective: Document March, the Welsh hero and corollary to king Mark of the Tristan and Iseult legend.
